what: The logo and sticker strip drift left on their own (.6px per frame), follow the hand when dragged, then slide with inertia and drift again. The strip content is chained in two copies to loop endlessly

options.scatter: If set, each cell tilts −35 to 35° and scatters height and position (sticker pile)
options.speed-narrow: Px flowing per frame on windows 750px or narrower — if absent, speed as is (brand .5)
options.drag: With ease, instead of inertia the drag distance × gain follows along over follow seconds with expo.out (no Draggable · InertiaPlugin). On release it flows again from where it is. With lerp it flows in seconds (speed × 60 px/s), catches up to the hand position with 1 − catch^dt while dragging, then on release glides at the drag speed and cools down with decay^dt (no Draggable · InertiaPlugin)
options.gain: drag: multiple of the distance pulled in ease, default 1.5
options.follow: drag: length (sec) to trail behind on ease, default 1
options.boost: Scroll adds extra flow of px moved per frame × boost, default 0 (sample .2)
options.catch: drag: in lerp, the share of remaining distance left after 1 second while dragging, default .002
options.decay: drag: share of the slide left per 1 second after release in lerp, default .02 (stops below 4px/s)
options.cap: drag: in lerp, max glide speed on release (px/s), default 1600
options.narrow: Window width (px) at which it switches to speed-narrow, default 750
options.per-px: Give a value and it flows by time instead of Frame — seconds per 1px (one loop = band width × per-px seconds). Appending ”window width:value” after it, like ”0.02 834:0.018 640:0.015”, uses that value in windows of that width or narrower (brand hero photo band). When given, speed is not used
options.dir: If right, flows to the right, default left (same in drag: lerp)
options.throw: If off, on release it flows again right on the spot with no inertia (without InertiaPlugin) — default is inertia
options.lap: Seconds for one band loop — if given, it flows by this instead of the frame and per-px (brand 60)
options.pause: With hover, the flow pauses while the pointer is over it (brand)
options.resist: Throw inertia resistance (throwResistance) — if given, uses that value (Brand 2600)
options.hover-speed: Multiplier of the automatic drift speed during interaction, default 1 (brand .8)
options.ramp: drag: in lerp, starts from rest and catches up to the flow speed by a ramp of the remaining share per frame (original .08, the first step of the strip that follows the flowing target by .08 per frame from the current spot). Without it, full speed from the start
options.wrap: With item, the strip is not pushed as a whole. Each cell moves separately, and only a cell that has fully passed the left end is wrapped to the right end by two widths (infinite strip js-ifs of the original). Without it, the whole strip folds at half width
options.inview: When true the strip flows only while it is on screen (rootMargin −10px). Off screen it stops in place and resumes when it comes back (Brand infinite strip INVIEW)
